nodes.summary: For a natural number $n \ge 2$, write $n = p_1^{\alpha_1} \cdots p_r^{\alpha_r}$ with primes $p_1 < \cdots < p_r$ and exponents $\alpha_i \ge 1$, and let $p_2$ be the least prime factor of $n / p_1^{\alpha_1}$. The conjectured value of $n$ is the rational number $\frac{n}{2}(1 - \frac{1}{p_1})$ if $r = 1$ and $\alpha_1 = 1$; $\frac{n}{2}(1 - \frac{1}{p_1}) + 1$ if $r = 1$ and $\alpha_1 \ge 2$;…
nodes.title: Bubboloni–Praeger–Spiga conjectured value

nodes.summary: It is not the case that there is a natural number $N$ such that, for every $n \ge N$, the normal covering number $\gamma(S_n)$ of the symmetric group $S_n$ equals the Bubboloni–Praeger–Spiga conjectured value of $n$. In other words, the conjecture fails for arbitrarily large $n$.
nodes.title: Refutation of the Bubboloni–Praeger–Spiga normal covering conjecture

nodes.summary: There is a natural number $N$ such that, for every $n \ge N$, the normal covering number $\gamma(S_n)$ of the symmetric group $S_n$ equals the Bubboloni–Praeger–Spiga conjectured value of $n$.
nodes.title: Bubboloni–Praeger–Spiga normal covering conjecture (eventual form)

nodes.summary: For a natural number $n$, the normal covering number $\gamma(S_n)$ is the least $k$ for which there are proper subgroups $H_1, \dots, H_k$ of the symmetric group $S_n$ such that every element of $S_n$ is conjugate to an element of some $H_i$. When no such subgroups exist, as for $n \le 2$, it is $0$.
nodes.title: Normal covering number of the symmetric group
